new endpoint for `crates/spice-cloud-client` for new spice cloud API `GET /v1/apps/{appId}/metrics` endpoint

Response format
```json
{
    "metrics": {
        "pod-name-1": {
        "cpu_usage_percent": 45.5,
        "memory_usage_bytes": 1073741824,
        "filesystem_usage_bytes": 5368709120,
        "filesystem_available_bytes": 10737418240,
        "filesystem_capacity_bytes": 16106127360
        }
    }
}
```
     
Error handling

- 400: Invalid app ID
- 401: Unauthorized (handled by withOAuth)
- 403: Insufficient scope
- 404: App not found
- 500: Chronosphere query failures (log error, return 500)
- If org has no Chronosphere token, return empty metrics {} (or 503)

    32→const DEFAULT_BASE_URL: &str = "https://api.spice.ai";
    33→const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
    34→
    35→/// HTTP client for the Spice Cloud API.
    36→pub struct CloudClient {
    37→    base_url: String,
    38→    client: Client,
    39→    token: Option<String>,
    40→}
    41→
    42→#[expect(
    43→    clippy::missing_errors_doc,
    44→    reason = "All public methods return Result with self-describing error types"
    45→)]
    46→impl CloudClient {
    47→    /// Create a new client with the given base URL.
    48→    ///
    49→    /// Use [`Self::with_token`] to set an authentication token, and
    50→    /// [`Self::with_timeout`] to override the default 30-second timeout.
    51→    #[must_use]
    52→    pub fn new(base_url: &str) -> Self {
    53→        Self {
    54→            base_url: base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
    55→            client: Client::builder()
    56→                .timeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
    57→                .build()
    58→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Client::new()),
    59→            token: None,
    60→        }
    61→    }
    62→
    63→    /// Create a new client pointing at the default production API.
    64→    #[must_use]
    65→    pub fn default_url() -> Self {
    66→        Self::new(DEFAULT_BASE_URL)
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    /// Set the bearer token used for authentication.
    70→    #[must_use]
    71→    pub fn with_token(mut self, token: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
    72→        self.token = Some(token.into());
    73→        self
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    /// Override the HTTP request timeout (default: 30 s).
    77→    ///
    78→    /// # Errors
    79→    ///
    80→    /// Returns an error if the HTTP client cannot be rebuilt with the given timeout.
    81→    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Self> {
    82→        self.client = Client::builder()
    83→            .timeout(timeout)
    84→            .build()
    85→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
    86→        Ok(self)
    87→    }

   102→        format!(

   104→            self.base_url.replace("api.", ""),
   105→            auth_code
   106→        )
   107→    }

   112→    pub async fn exchange_code(&self, auth_code: &str) -> Result<Option<AuthExchangeResponse>> {

   114→            "{}/v1/auth/device/exchange?code={}",

   116→        );

   118→            .client
   119→            .get(&url)
   120→            .send()
   121→            .await

   427→async fn execute_login(args: &LoginArgs) -> Result<()> {
   428→    use crate::commands::login::merge_auth_config;
   429→    use rand::Rng;
   430→
   431→    // Generate auth code
   432→    const CHARSET: &[u8] = b"REDACTED";
   433→    let mut rng = rand::rng();
   434→    let auth_code: String = (0..8)
   435→        .map(|_| {
   436→            let idx = rng.random_range(0..CHARSET.len());
   437→            CHARSET[idx] as char
   438→        })
   439→        .collect();
   440→
   441→    let client = CloudClient::new_unauthenticated();
   442→    let auth_url = client.get_auth_url(&auth_code);
   443→
   444→    println!("Opening Spice Cloud authorization page in your default browser...");
   445→    println!(
   446→        "\nYour auth code:\n\n  {}-{}\n",
   447→        &auth_code[..4],
   448→        &auth_code[4..]
   449→    );
   450→    println!("If the browser does not open, visit the following URL manually:");
   451→    println!("\n  {auth_url}\n");
   452→
   453→    if !args.no_browser {
   454→        let _ = open::that(&auth_url);
   455→    }
   456→
   457→    println!("Waiting for authentication...");
   458→
   459→    // Poll for auth status
   460→    let timeout = std::time::Duration::from_secs(300); // 5 minutes
   461→    let start = std::time::Instant::now();
   462→
   463→    loop {
   464→        if start.elapsed() > timeout {
   465→            return InvalidArgumentSnafu {
   466→                message: "Authentication timed out. Please try again.",
   467→            }
   468→            .fail();
   469→        }
   470→
   471→        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
   472→
   473→        if let Ok(Some(response)) = client.exchange_code(&auth_code).await {
   474→            if response.access_denied {
   475→                return InvalidArgumentSnafu {
   476→                    message: "Access denied",
   477→                }
   478→                .fail();
   479→            }
   480→
   481→            if let Some(token) = response.access_token {
   482→                // Save the token
   483→                merge_auth_config("SPICEAI", &[("TOKEN", &token)])?;
   484→
   485→                // Get user info
   486→                let authed_client = CloudClient::new()?;
   487→                if let Ok(context) = authed_client.get_auth_context().await {
   488→                    if let Some(api_key) = context.app_api_key {
   489→                        merge_auth_config("SPICEAI", &[("API_KEY", &api_key)])?;
   490→                    }
   491→                    println!();
   492→                    println!(
   493→                        "\x1b[32m✓ Successfully logged in to Spice Cloud as {} ({})\x1b[0m",
   494→                        context.username, context.email
   495→                    );
   496→                } else {
   497→                    println!("\n\x1b[32m✓ Successfully logged in to Spice Cloud\x1b[0m");
   498→                }
   499→
   500→                println!();
   501→                println!(
   502→                    "You can now use 'spice cloud' commands to manage your apps and deployments."
   503→                );
   504→                println!();
   505→                println!("Quick start:");
   506→                println!("  spice cloud apps              - List your apps");
   507→                println!("  spice cloud create app <name> - Create a new app");
   508→                println!("  spice cloud deploy --app <org/app> - Deploy your app");
   509→
   510→                return Ok(());
   511→            }
   512→        }
   513→    }
   514→}

   516→fn execute_logout() -> Result<()> {
   517→    // Remove Spice.ai auth tokens
   518→    let env_file = if std::path::Path::new(".env.local").exists() {
   519→        ".env.local"
   520→    } else {
   521→        ".env"
   522→    };
   523→
   524→    let path = std::path::Path::new(env_file);
   525→    if !path.exists() {
   526→        println!("\x1b[32m✓ Already logged out\x1b[0m");
   527→        return Ok(());
   528→    }
   529→
   530→    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_default();
   531→    let lines: Vec<&str> = content
   532→        .lines()
   533→        .filter(|line| {
   534→            !line.starts_with("SPICE_SPICEAI_TOKEN=") && !line.starts_with("SPICE_SPICEAI_API_KEY=")
   535→        })
   536→        .collect();
   537→
   538→    if lines.is_empty()
   539→        || lines
   540→            .iter()
   541→            .all(|l| l.trim().is_empty() || l.starts_with('#'))
   542→    {
   543→        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(path);
   544→    } else {
   545→        let new_content = lines.join("\n");
   546→        std::fs::write(path, new_content).map_err(|e| crate::error::Error::ConfigIo {
   547→            operation: "write",
   548→            path: path.to_path_buf(),
   549→            source: e,
   550→        })?;
   551→    }
   552→
   553→    println!("\x1b[32m✓ Successfully logged out from Spice Cloud\x1b[0m");
